decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game. With cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Curiosity, the deck aims to get ahead on mana early on and overwhelm the opponent with threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble provide board control and disruption, while Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opposing strategies. The deck's key strategy is to ramp up mana quickly, play big threats, and control the game until victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures and utilizing various burn spells to control the board and deal damage to the opponent quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Thraben Charm provide additional versatility and reach. The deck aims to apply early pressure, maintain board presence, and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and counterspells like Force of Negation, while utilizing cards like Thought Scour and Dreams of Steel and Oil to dig for answers and disrupt the opponent's hand. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat that can close out the game quickly, while cards like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus offer additional utility and card advantage.

This UWx Midrange deck focuses on controlling the board through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage for card advantage. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Flame of Anor to close out games quickly. With a strong mana base and a mix of control elements and threats, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a dominant board presence of its own.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies while utilizing blink effects to gain value from entering the battlefield abilities. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence. The deck also includes Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and Recruiter of the Guard to tutor for specific creatures. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early on with aggressive creatures and then protect them with blink effects and removal spells to secure victory.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Control elements are present with cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and disruption, while Nulldrifter and Sowing Mycospawn help with card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats while controlling the game with removal and disruption.

The deck focuses on using ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans to quickly accelerate mana production in order to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own game plan. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and access to sideboard cards while Nulldrifter and Sowing Mycospawn offer card advantage and board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its Eldrazi threats while controlling the game with removal and disruption spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and controlling the game through various means such as counterspells, removal, and efficient card advantage tools. Urza, Lord High Artificer and Emry, Lurker of the Loch provide strong synergy with artifacts while Urza's Saga allows for toolbox searching and value generation. Whir of Invention is used to tutor specific key pieces while Portable Hole and Pithing Needle are effective at dealing with opposing threats. The deck aims to establish a board presence through Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly build a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By combining artifact creatures with powerful artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to control the board while pressuring the opponent with aggressive attacks. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage and synergy with the artifact-focused strategy. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Pithing Needle and Metallic Rebuke helps to protect the deck's game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The focus of this deck revolves around ramping up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor, and then efficiently utilizing Primeval Titan to search for key lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens to set up powerful combo plays. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to generate additional value and flexibility, this deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm opponents with its explosive combos and efficient land-based strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Amulet of Vigor combo with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Primeval Titan. This allows for explosive ramping and land plays, leading to powerful combos with lands like Lotus Field and Urza's Saga. The deck also includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle for additional advantage. The goal is to win through strong land-based plays and powerful combinations that overwhelm the opponent before they can react effectively.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays backed up by powerful support cards. The key strategy involves overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd for additional damage and control. Static Prison and Thraben Charm help control the board, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory provide additional support and synergy. The deck is designed to quickly build a threatening board presence and apply consistent pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard hate. It aims to control the game by preventing threats from resolving, while also utilizing cards like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog to apply pressure and close out the game. The deck also has a toolbox of options like Consider and Nihil Spellbomb to adapt to different matchups. Overall, the key strategy is to maintain control of the game and outvalue the opponent through efficient plays and resource management.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to control the game by playing threats like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus while denying the opponent's spells with cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Unearth for removal and card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the board and the opponent's resources to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo pieces and spells to control the game without relying on traditional land plays. It aims to quickly assemble the necessary components to win the game through efficient card draw, counterspells, and creature removal. By utilizing a mix of creatures, artifacts, and disruptive spells, the deck can disrupt opponent strategies while setting up its own win condition through cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Thundertrap Trainer. The deck's lack of reliance on lands allows for a unique and unpredictable playstyle in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana through spells like Desperate Ritual and Ruby Medallion to cast powerful cards like Past in Flames and Ral, Monsoon Mage. It also includes cards like Glimpse the Impossible and Wrenn's Resolve to set up explosive turns and finish the game with a combo finish. The deck aims to chain spells together to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage, allowing the player to overwhelm their opponent in a single turn.
